assumptions_and_limitations.randomization_and_ignorability: Conditional Ignorability (Unconfoundedness): Treatment assignment T is randomized independently of potential outcomes (Y(1), Y(0)) conditional on pre-cutoff covariates X.
assumptions_and_limitations.sutva: Stable Unit Treatment Value Assumption (SUTVA): One customer's retention offer does not spill over or alter another customer's churn behavior, and each campaign tier has a well-defined treatment version.
assumptions_and_limitations.positivity_overlap: Positivity (Common Support): Every customer segment has a strictly positive probability 0 < P(T=1|X) < 1 of being assigned to either treatment or control.
assumptions_and_limitations.t_learner_limitations: T-Learner Statistical Limitations: Because the T-Learner fits two separate models (mu_0 and mu_1) independently, regularization bias and estimation noise in each base model can compound when taking their difference (tau = mu_0 - mu_1). High-variance regions require sample-size awareness and confidence interval reporting.
